example.name: locator_healing
example.scenario: Fix a test that fails due to UI changes.
example.error_context:
Error: TimeoutError: Element not found: .btn-primary
at LoginPage.login (login_page.py:45) at test_login_success (test_login.py:28)

trace_analysis.observation: Screenshot shows button exists but class changed
Button now has class "btn btn-primary" instead of "btn-primary"
Button has role="button" and text="Sign In"

key_takeaways.takeaway: CSS selectors break when styles change
Use semantic selectors that reflect user intent

example.name: timing_healing
example.scenario: Fix a flaky test with timing issues.
example.error_context:
Error: AssertionError: Element not visible
at test_dashboard_load (test_dashboard.py:32)

trace_analysis.observation: Element exists in DOM but not visible
Network request completes before element renders

key_takeaways.takeaway: Wait for specific element, not arbitrary time

example.name: data_healing
example.scenario: Fix a test that fails due to stale test data.
example.error_context:
Error: AssertionError: Expected "John Doe" but got ""
at test_user_profile (test_user.py:45)

trace_analysis.observation: Test expects user name to be "John Doe"
Database was reset, user name is now empty

example.fix_applied:
# Before def test_user_profile(self, page: Page): page.goto("/profile") expect(page.get_by_text("John Doe")).to_be_visible()
# After def test_user_profile(self, page: Page, user_fixture: dict): page.goto("/profile") expect(page.get_by_text(user_fixture["name"])).to_be_visible()

key_takeaways.takeaway: Avoid hardcoded expected values Load expected data from fixtures
